snc.text: Anhelo is Xander's vampire deacon, whom Xander orders to secretly learn about the Cabaretti's rumored new Halo supply, and who offers Elspeth work with the Maestros and takes her to their museum once she agrees to join the family.

On the eve of his daughter Errant's wedding, he takes a job for Toluz and beheads the traitor Fiero Vespin in the Maestros' museum, then survives a trap set by Severo Jr., who lures him into a cab to avenge his father, and Toluz saves him from the Riveteers.
He reaches the bridal suite in time and is reunited with Errant on her wedding day, and he says the only family he cares about is in that room.

On the eve of the Crescendo, Xander names Anhelo his heir and sends him out the receiving door, and after Nixilis kills Xander, the Maestros are left to Anhelo, who gives Elspeth and Vivien Xander's letter.
